summary.text: Lauri Shillings is the Libertarian Party nominee for Secretary of State. She is a graphic designer, business owner and adjunct professor from Indiana.

paragraphs.text: Earned an associate degree from Ivy Tech Community College and a bachelor's degree from the University of Indianapolis (2023).
Has worked as a graphic designer, business owner, adjunct professor and director, and has been affiliated with the Libertarian Party of Indiana and the Hamilton County Libertarian Party.
